events.title: Pound Rises Ahead Of Fed Warsh's Speech
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday, as traders now look to U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh's speech.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Choppy Trade; IT Stocks Extend Surge
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher in choppy trade on Friday after posting strong gains in the previous session, led by banking and information technology stocks.

events.title: Pound Rises Against Majors
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: Antipodean Currencies Rise Amid Risk-on Mood
events.description: The Antipodean currencies such as the Australia and the New Zealand dollars strengthened against their major currencies in the Asian session on Friday, as Asian stock markets traded higher, boosted by strong gains in Japan and South Korea amid a rebound in technology and semiconductor stocks after the recent sell-off on concerns over rising costs of financing AI investments.

events.title: Australian Dollar Advances Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is maintaining its early gains in mid-market moves on Friday, reversing the losses in the previous two sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving up to near the 8,800 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining a technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Higher
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly higher on Friday, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, boosted by strong gains in Japan and South Korea amid a rebound in technology and semiconductor stocks after the recent sell-off on concerns over rising costs of financing AI investments. Asian markets ended mostly lower on Thursday.

events.title: Indian Shares Set To Follow Global Peers Higher With Lower Yields In Focus
events.description: Indian shares look set to open higher on Friday, tracking firm cues from global markets as a selloff in chip stocks eased and bond markets steadied after recent turbulence.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Find Renewed Support On Friday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market turned lower again on Thursday, one day after snapping the two-day slide in which it had dropped almost 170 points or 2.9 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,860-point plateau although it's likely to bounce higher again on Friday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is trading sharply higher on Friday, snapping a six session losing streak, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving well above the 65,500 level, with gains across most sectors led by technology and financial stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, dropping more than 280 points or 1.2 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,060-point plateau although it's expected to open to the upside on Friday.

events.title: China Bourse Tipped To Open In The Green
events.description: The China stock market has moved lower in consecutive trading days, stumbling almost 100 points or 3.2 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,700-point plateau although it may find traction on Friday.
